rural_master.role: user-approved Brazilian farm content, relative scale, rural zones, infrastructure and scene richness

terrain_master.role: ground treatment: grass/earth transition, asset grounding, organic edges, localized wear, controlled vegetation
terrain_master.status: selected terrain reference; terrain-family approval remains pending

selected_grounding_overlay.role: user-selected V2 grounding overlay; asset-specific approval only

composition_master.role: scene composition grammar only: diorama footprint, visual hierarchy, connected masses and balanced density; not a sprite finish, palette, or subject-matter authority

orientation_probe.interpretation: supports repeated isometric directions; not a direct ground-grid calibration

reference_resolution.sprite_source_export: native-authored-pixel-grid; do not derive pixel art by downsampling

outline_rules.color: deep material-relative colors; avoid universal pure black
outline_rules.status: provisional; verify at native resolution and 100% zoom

lighting_direction.status: provisional; verify on both approved references

palette.extraction_method: scripts/assets/measure_style_references.py: Pillow median-cut 12-color palette after excluding neutral near-white pixels (HSV saturation < 0.10, value > 0.93)
palette.status: urban reference chips are descriptive measurements only; Riose material palette remains to be calibrated from approved sprites and terrain V2

saturation_median_after_neutral_near_whi.interpretation: Descriptive source measurements; urban image has composition-reference role only and does not govern Riose palette.

palette.role_mapping_status: provisional; median-cut clusters do not identify material roles
palette.rural_reference_palette_policy: Use V7 for content and scale only; calibrate terrain colors to Riose V2 and asset colors to approved sprite anchors.

fur.detail: silhouette and breed markers; avoid fur texture

foliage.detail: distinct canopy masses, deliberate clusters, no repeated round blobs

wood.detail: structural grain only; preserve connector readability

metal.detail: flat cool planes, sparse fasteners, no glossy reflections

earth.detail: large surface groups and intentional tracks, no global grain

water.detail: graphic bands and restrained highlights, no photographic reflections

sprite_anchor_conventions.world_props: normalized ground contact point, usually x=0.5 and y=1.0

rendering_filters.texture_scale: nearest-neighbor only for integer zoom of natively authored pixels

shadow_conventions.contact: short, hard-edged, restrained; separate layer where practical
shadow_conventions.cast: consistent lower-right direction; exclude from isolated sprites unless specified

pixel_density.rule: native deliberate clusters; maintain visual consistency with approved Riose sprite anchors at equal display scale; use the urban image only for scene-composition comparison

scene_density.rule: use urban reference for connected-zone composition and hierarchy; use rural V7 for content/scale/richness; use Riose V2 for terrain density and grounding
scene_density.status: rural scene approved; individual assets not implied approved
